data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 5.8m (2023: GBP 3.4m) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Favourable development in the 2022 underwriting year leading to a reduction in gross claims outstanding.
Commutation of 2021 year of account into Syndicate 2791, removing related reserves from Syndicate 6103.

named_events.loss_description: The current ultimate estimated losses for Helene are gross/net $22.0m (uncertainty remains around the ultimate outcome).
The current ultimate estimated losses for Milton are gross/net $25.8m (uncertainty remains around the ultimate outcome).
Post-reporting period wildfires expected to have a material impact on Syndicate 6103, with current anticipated net impact in the region of $30-50m (market loss $30-50bn).

data.standardized_narrative: At the 2024 year end Syndicate 6103 carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 53.375m (opening balance GBP 35.077m). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a net favourable movement on prior years (principally the 2022 underwriting year) of approximately GBP 2.0m (release). The notes also record a commutation (RITC) of the 2021 year of account into Syndicate 2791 which reduced reserves. The report highlights ongoing exposures to US property catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Helene and Milton in 2024) and a post-year event (Los Angeles wildfires Jan 2025) expected to materially affect the 2024 year; those losses are quoted in USD in the report and are not converted here.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 5.8m (2023: GBP 3.4m) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
The syndicate has material exposure to both Hurricane Helene and Hurricane Milton.
The current ultimate estimated losses for Helene and Milton are gross/net $22.0m and gross/net $25.8m respectively.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was derived from the gross claims development table (triangle) for underwriting year 2022 (gross change 55,043 - 57,087 = -2,044 GBP 000 => -2.044m). Narrative in the notes reports a net favourable movement of GBP 5.8m (net of reinsurance) which differs from the gross triangle-derived number; gross movement was not explicitly stated in narrative. Some loss figures for specific events are quoted in USD in the report and were not converted to GBP. RITC activity (2021 commuted) distorts multi-year comparisons and limits the triangle to 2022-2024 columns only.
